# ResumeProof Match

> ResumeProof Match is an evidence-first AI tool for comparing a resume with a job description, verifying each match against resume excerpts, reviewing suggested edits, and exporting an approved resume.

Primary language: Simplified Chinese. English content is also available.
Last updated: 2026-09-02.

## Key pages

- [Chinese homepage](https://resumeproof.szw19990924.chatgpt.site/): Product overview and entry point.
- [English homepage](https://resumeproof.szw19990924.chatgpt.site/en): English product overview.
- [Chinese resume matching guide](https://resumeproof.szw19990924.chatgpt.site/guide): Evidence-first method, common mistakes, and FAQs.
- [English resume matching guide](https://resumeproof.szw19990924.chatgpt.site/en/guide): Evidence-first method, common mistakes, and FAQs.
- [About](https://resumeproof.szw19990924.chatgpt.site/about): Purpose, workflow, and boundaries.

- [AI-agent Skill](https://github.com/caihhhhhh/resume-proof-match): Open-source matching and delivery workflow.

## Core principles

- Role fit, evidence coverage, and resume expression are separate judgments.
- A supported match must point to a verifiable resume excerpt.
- Missing experience remains a gap; it is not converted into a keyword or invented claim.
- Suggested edits require user review before they enter the final draft.
- Scores are decision aids, not ATS pass probabilities or hiring predictions.
